title: chat.message.created payload (v1)
description: Emitted when a message logical row is created and sequenced. Identifier- and metadata-level only; this event never includes ciphertext, payload bytes, device labels, raw public keys, or plaintext chat content. Envelope contract: aggregate_type 'message', aggregate_id 'message_id', aggregate_version 1. Rationale for the message aggregate: using the message itself as the aggregate keeps 'aggregate_version' from being overloaded with the conversation-level version space, since a conversation produces one message row per sequence number; per-conversation ordering is carried by 'seq' in this payload, and consumers must never infer conversation-scoped ordering or aggregate currency from broker aggregate_version of other aggregates.

message_id.description: Soft reference to chat_db.messages.id; also the envelope aggregate_id.

seq.description: Conversation-local ordering sequence issued by locking and updating conversations.last_seq; authoritative for per-conversation ordering.

sender_id.description: Sender account; soft reference to chat_db.chat_users.id.

sender_device_id.description: Device that produced the envelope; soft reference to chat_db.chat_devices.id and known to belong to sender_id.

payload_mode.description: Delivery mode: 'shared' carries one group ciphertext for all authorized members, 'per_device' uses device-specific envelopes.

reply_to_id.description: Quoted message in the same conversation, or null. The quoted text itself stays encrypted and is never attached to this event.
